_comment: Nemesis design tokens — mobile's half of the shared visual identity with the desktop app. Values are the desktop theme's dark-mode seeds (owner-specified 2026-07-16): monochrome surfaces, ONE crimson accent, radiusScalar 1.0. This is the ONLY source of color/radius values for the mission screens (apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx, apps/mobile/src/app/mission/[id].tsx) and the chrome touch-ups that wrap them. A future export-design-tokens.mjs run in nemesis-desktop-public should regenerate this file wholesale rather than hand-editing individual values.
